meta.notes: A block transformer says what using a tool on a block does: a list of transforms, tried in order, each with a block state provider whose rules pick the new block and the sound it plays. This one turns coarse dirt into a dirt path with the shovel sound. Vanilla tools read the transformers named after them, so naming one minecraft:shovel would replace what every shovel does; under a name of its own, like this one, nothing uses it yet.
